This section features official computational problem sets, instructions for the capstone group project, and exam preparation packages for PHYD57.

### Submission Policies
- Deadlines are strictly at 11:00 AM on lecture Fridays via Quercus.
- Submissions late by >3 hours earn 50% penalty. No extensions.
- Code must include clear comments explaining algorithm steps.
